behavior: PDCP header source defaults to Automatic. Manual Hex remains available and retains its own independent cached value.
All header fields, source/type/SN/D-C/flag/prefix settings, generated preview, SDAP presence and manual Hex share Tk variables across transmit and receive. Payload text remains tab-local.
COUNT is parsed consistently in Decimal/Hex/Bit. Only its low SN bits form the header; the full 32-bit COUNT still enters the security primitives.
D/C=0 is rejected by automatic Data PDU generation. SRB and SLRB do not contain D/C.
LTE DRB P is available only for 18-bit SN in DL; AILC only for 12-bit SN in UL. Inactive settings are retained but do not affect generated bytes.
LTE SLRB 16-bit SN requires the actual 3-byte prefix. Other header format variants remain available through Manual Hex.
SDAP stays manual and is never regenerated or overwritten when direction/format changes.
Invalid automatic input clears the preview in both tabs; calculation recomputes the header independently of the preview and cannot reuse stale bytes.

validation.note: Header encoding expectations are derived from standard layout figures and separate from the 135 official algorithm vectors.

limitations: RRC bearer configuration is not decoded; the user chooses the actual LTE/NR format and flags.
SLRB identity-prefix contents and Manual Hex semantics are supplied by the user, not inferred from COUNT.
Automatic UDC variants and full PDCP/SDAP protocol state machines are not implemented; Manual Hex is available for other header forms. NCA remains excluded.
Windows source/EXE checks use Windows Server 2025 hosted CI; Windows 11 visual/DPI testing was not repeated.
No Markdown documents were modified; no main merge or release publication was performed.
